items.text: Little optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) will play Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week with expectation he won’t go. Rams get Puka Nacua back as Eagles prepare without Smith.
items.why: Hamstring; sources indicate not much optimism for Sunday
items.implication: Hurts volume drop potential; Wicks elevated; Nacua return boosts LAR pass game
items.opportunity: Dontayvion Wicks high-end WR3 upside; Nacua full role expected

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury sustained in Week 3; will miss minimum of four games. No surgery required.
items.why: Hamstring injury; coach Kellen Moore confirmed IR placement
items.implication: Misses at least Weeks 4-7; backfield becomes committee
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining RBs in NO offense

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play this week (TNF). Last week 90% snap rate, 20 of 22 RB touches with Dowdle out; believes in him despite short week after big usage.
items.why: Elite usage (90% snaps, near-monopoly touches); Dowdle likely out again
items.implication: Strong RB2/FLEX start vs Browns; volume floor high
items.opportunity: Continued 80%+ snap/touch share if Dowdle misses

items.text: Lamar Jackson (back) and Zay Flowers (hamstring) upgraded to full participants Thursday after limited Wednesday; among multiple Ravens upgrades.
items.why: Practice upgrade; Flowers first full since Week 1 leadup
items.implication: Clear path to full snaps/workload vs Titans; Flowers WR1 upside unlocked
items.opportunity: Unrestricted routes/targets for Flowers; Jackson dual-threat intact

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed is out for the season.
items.implication: GB WR depth chart shuffle; Wicks/others elevated long-term
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Packers pass-catchers

items.text: De'Von Achane suffered torn ACL in Week 3 vs Chiefs, ending his season. Creates long-term opportunity in Miami backfield amid low-scoring offense.
items.implication: Season over; waiver priority on remaining MIA RBs despite poor team offense

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles after missing Weeks 2-3; limited practice Wednesday but trending up.
items.why: McVay comments on progress and expectation to play
items.implication: Immediate WR1 return; Adams may see reduced target share
items.opportunity: Full route/target share restoration for Nacua

items.text: Fresh ETR Rest of Season rankings live: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall. Notable high placements also include Parker Washington 22, Saquon 30.
items.why: Updated for injuries/roles/schedule; Walker monster usage early
items.implication: Elite hold/trade target; strong ROS value
items.opportunity: Continued high snap/carry share in KC

items.text: Jeremiyah Love saw 26 touches in Week 3 (more than Weeks 1-2 combined), 78% of team rush attempts; Utilization Score 91 (5th among RBs).
items.why: Explosive volume spike and high utilization
items.implication: Emerging lead back in ARI; must-roster/start candidate

items.text: In first game back, Brock Bowers saw 43% target share and perfect 100 Utilization Score. Career avg over 20 PPG in 25%+ target share games.
items.why: Elite target share immediately upon return

items.text: Zay Flowers Week 3: 29% snaps/14 routes but 43% target rate on those, 30% target share, 41 FP on 37 snaps season, 19.5 YPT. Efficiency monster.
items.why: High target rate and YPT despite snap limits; now full practice
items.implication: WR1 upside with full snaps unlocked

items.text: Pat Thorman Week 4 Snaps & Pace: DAL @ HOU up in pace; LAC @ SEA slow slog; other matchups noted. Full rankings also posted.
items.implication: Favor players in high-pace games (DAL/HOU); caution slow ones
items.opportunity: Higher expected plays for DAL/HOU skill players

items.text: In 2-for-1 trade of Zay Flowers + Montgomery for Jonathan Taylor, prefers the JT side; typically want the '1' when close, and ETR favors Taylor anyway.
items.why: Trade calculator and preference for workhorse RB1
items.implication: JT strong buy; Flowers still valuable but side with single elite piece

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT. Chart shows him among biggest underperformers of actual opportunity.
items.why: Low volume, no red-zone, low aDOT despite opportunity metrics
items.implication: Avoid/start with extreme caution even with Penix; fade in rankings
items.conflict: Berry notes low target share historically with Penix
